analyst.summary: Siemens Ltd, post the April-2025 demerger of its Energy business into separately listed Siemens Energy India, is now a pure Smart Infrastructure / Digital Industries / Mobility franchise with a genuinely strong order book -- led by a record ~Rs 13,000cr, 1,200-unit locomotive contract with Indian Railways now beginning an 11-year execution ramp, plus Smart Infrastructure orders riding the data-centre and power-utility capex cycle. But the continuing-operations margin trend is a real, current concern: comparing only the four fully-post-demerger quarters (the only apples-to-apples read, since the demerger removed a higher-margin segment and mechanically depressed reported YoY profit), operating margin has fallen sequentially for a full year (12% to ~9.6-10%), with gross margin down 449bps YoY in the latest quarter on commodity and currency cost pressure. The quant snapshot's PE of 61.9 likely blends pre- and post-demerger EPS and understates the true picture: on a clean TTM basis (EPS Rs 43.68 against a ~Rs 3,500 price), the real multiple is closer to 80x -- richer than ABB India's already sell-side-flagged-as-stretched band, and without ABB's offsetting three-quarters-of-accelerating-orders story. Balance sheet is pristine (D/E 0.02, zero red flags) and the 75%-promoter (Siemens AG) scarcity premium is real, but sell-side itself is split (ICICI Sec Hold Rs 4,190 target; Nomura Neutral Rs 3,343, below CMP). No thesis break, so Hold -- but this is a name to watch closely on margins, not to add to at current pricing.
